test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 16 March, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
How many wrappers are not pens?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d0bbccd963a6d7a85ac2b3766d0537fec68eac5073c50ce73781852f0369de94.png]
solution:
According to the given Venn diagram:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e804b5d2be727541cb2c4a7395bbb0fce5ad2a70186936ab50baf72063193a0c.png] 

The shaded area shows the "total number of wrappers are not pens".

So, the total number of 'wrappers are not pens' = 6 + 12 = 18.

Hence, the correct answer is "18".
